'blind_1' was written by the independent judge of round 5 (80 crisis, 60 innocent, 50 sensitive messages); the search caught 35 of the 80 crisis messages then. 'fresh_1', 'fresh_2' and 'fresh_3' were then written, one after another, each in an independent blind review (the reviewer wrote the messages before seeing the code or lists); each was run once before any change was made for it ('first_look') and then used to develop the distress gate, so no set here is held out any more. 'accepted' lists the messages whose category the lists knowingly get wrong: when in doubt the gate fires. 'judge5_held_out' (122 crisis, 40 bereavement, 60 innocent, 50 sensitive) was held out for one run, whose results are fixed in its 'first_run'; it was then used for development in round 6 and is a regression set now.
